title: After reboot, cannot get weather info for any location until switching weather stations
line: The Weather widget now loads the forecast by itself shortly after the network comes up at login or after waking, instead of staying on "Unable to load weather forecast".
explanation: At login or resume the widget asks for the forecast before the provider is reachable (DNS/route not ready although the network is reported online). The request fails, and the failed result is stored with a fresh update time, so nothing tries again until the next update interval (30 minutes by default), and even the resume handler skips it as 'not outdated'. Switching location worked because it creates a new request. Now a failed update is never treated as fresh data, and ForecastControl retries it after 30 seconds, doubling the delay after each failure up to the update interval; a successful update resets it.

commits.message:
applets/weather: retry soon after a failed forecast update

A failed update counted as fresh data, so if the network wasn't up yet
after login or resume nothing was fetched until the next interval. Now
it is retried after 30 seconds, doubling the delay after each failure.

BUG: 507273

media.caption: Master: plasmashell started with the network unreachable for its first 45 s; 2 minutes after the network is back the widget still says "Unable to load weather forecast" (no further request in the log).
With the fix, same 45 s outage: the widget retries after 30 s and 60 s and shows the Kapuskasing, ON forecast about a minute after the network is back.
